split.design: Training includes all input-space convex hull vertices; remaining IDs RNG42
split.selection_uses: I_A and Thet_deg only; no target field/error values
split.evaluation_scope: new operating conditions inside training parameter convex hull; shared time/space

protocol.features: I_RMS, native Thet, sin(h*absolute_mechanical_angle), cos(h*angle); first-period h1/h2 prevent enforced electrical endpoint equality
protocol.input_definition: native model RMS, four parallel branches, no /2; Thet is not dq beta
stages: uniform physical field MSE changes only loss
frozen uniform model + same-weight neural residual branch
validation-selected MLP + train-condition RBF coefficient residual; pure RBF control
protocol.local_acceptance: validation hotspot RMSE decreases; overall/ordinary/worst-case RMSE each <=1.02*uniform; max_abs reported independently
protocol.hotspot_definition: training errors of seed42 uniform field model; distinct from supplied geometric hotspot
protocol.final_evaluation: only after all validation selection and seed checks are frozen; no test-based tuning
claims: new operating-condition interpolation, shared 60 frames, fixed sampled spatial points
protocol.metrics: float64 RMSE, MAE, max_abs and 100*||error||2/||truth||2 over sampled vector components; no FEM area weights available
